gloss: from the best to the worst; of every grade

definitions.gloss: from the best to the worst; of every grade
definitions.explanation: Covering the whole range, from the very best (or most expensive) to the very worst (or cheapest). Said of things whose quality or price varies widely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ピンからキリまで⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Prices range from top to bottom.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ピンからキリまでだ。

⟦{一口|ひとくち}→一口：10474_hitokuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{専門学校|せんもんがっこう}→専門学校：04859_senmongakkou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、ピンからキリまで⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Vocational schools range from excellent to poor, so you should look into them carefully.

notes:
From Portuguese: ピン (pinta, a dot, the one on a die or card) is the first and best, and キリ (possibly cruz, a cross, meaning ten) the last. The expression is neutral and very common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ピンからキリまで⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: ~ ranges from the best to the worst
- ピンからキリまで⟦{揃|そろ}っている→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: everything from top grade to bottom grade is available

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧: various — says only that things differ, not that they range in quality
- ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from top to bottom
